description: Notification matrix (FR-NOTIF-01..04). `types` keys equal the DB CHECK on notifications.type and the NotificationType enum. `producedBy` lists operationIds (or system jobs) that emit the notification after their transaction commits; `recipients` are logical groups resolved to users by the worker of notification.dispatch (ACTIVE, non-deleted users only, deduplicated by user id); `payload` lists the exact keys of Notification.payload. One IN_APP row is always created per recipient; EMAIL/TELEGRAM rows follow the user's channel settings, except for `forcedChannels` types, which go to every available channel (email always, Telegram when linked) regardless of settings (FR-NOTIF-03).

recipientGroups.labOrg: all users of the lab organization of the test
recipientGroups.labOrgHeads: users with is_org_admin = true of the lab organization of the test
recipientGroups.batchOrigin: all users of the batch origin organization
recipientGroups.batchHolder: all users of the batch holder organization (skipped when equal to batchOrigin)
recipientGroups.waybillReceiver: all users of the waybill receiver organization
recipientGroups.taskHolder: all users of the recall task holder organization
recipientGroups.taskHolders: all users of every organization holding a task of the recall
recipientGroups.sourceOrigin: all users of the origin organization of the recall source batch
recipientGroups.inspectorsIfUnplanned: all users with role INSPECTOR, only when the lab test reason is INSPECTOR or COMPLAINT

producedBy: recall engine at creation (event CLOSED, vacuous BR-10 close with no tasks: notification.dispatch in the same transaction, R59)
